title: EIP-8367: Balance sunset for retired BLS validators
description: Gradually reduce balances of retired 0x00 validators to zero on a published schedule ahead of the post-quantum transition
author: NC (@ensi321)
laymanDescription: Retiring the old genesis-era validators leaves thousands of frozen entries holding real ether that the network must carry forever. This proposal caps their balances at a ceiling that falls to zero over a published multi-year schedule, so the final cleanup deletes nothing anyone owns.
benefits: A declining balance reaches owners through dashboards and alerts that announcements never did
Rotating credentials at any point during the window releases the entire remaining balance
Missing part of a gradual schedule costs a fraction; missing a one-time deadline costs everything
tradeoffs: Burns the balances of anyone who does not act, chiefly holders of lost withdrawal keys
Sets the precedent of the protocol reducing balances of a class defined by credential type
The schedule must be re-tuned at intermediate forks if the post-quantum timeline moves
